_doc: EXAMPLE namespace registry for scripts/mcp/graph_mcp/server.py. Copy it next to your graph,
rename the namespaces to your own taxonomy, and point GRAPH_NAMESPACES_FILE at the copy.
Without GRAPH_NAMESPACES_FILE the server loads this file as is.
namespaces.<Name>.domain     a key from 'domains', for grouping in graph_stats
namespaces.<Name>.template   optional page skeleton appended by create_page(use_template=true), or null
namespaces.<Name>.protected  true = readable, never writable through the server (create, update, append refused)
namespaces.<Name>.obsidian_folder  optional, Obsidian only: store this namespace in a differently named folder
Journal is a namespace for notes ABOUT days. Logseq's own daily journals live in journals/ and are read
with read_journal; on Obsidian, set GRAPH_DAILY_FOLDER=Journal to make the two the same folder.
An unreadable or malformed registry stops the server at startup. It never falls back to 'no rules'.
